'''la bauspo fazykamni''' (the language-destroying annoying-group; also known as the BSFK) is the evil counterpart to the [[BPFK]]. Founded by [[User:Spheniscine|la zipcpi]], its sole purpose is to destroy Lojban as a usable language, once and for all.

==Methods==

* Make extremely silly words like '''[http://jbovlaste.lojban.org/dict/briii briii]''' and '''[http://jbovlaste.lojban.org/dict/ci'onme'a ci'onme'a]'''
* Make lots of half-baked proposals
* Get on everyone's nerves by making pseudo-authoritative statements about the language, and pushing for any intended changes to happen quickly (note: any member of the BSFK is allowed to invoke the "authority" of the BSFK for any statement/idea/proposal they may have on the language, without having to consult or discuss with any other member)

==Motto==

'''bu'a'a'a'a'a'a'a'a'a''' (untranslatable to English)

==Disclaimer==

'''''fu'o zo'osai'' Yes, all this is a joke.'''
